// diagnostic E0448

Jet.SemicolonAfterArm

A `;` can't follow a one-line arm on the same line

What

A `;` can't follow a one-line arm on the same line

Why

A one-line arm holds one statement, so the code after this `;` could belong to the arm or run after it, and Jet will not guess which.

Fix

Brace the arm to run both under it, as in `-> { a(); b() }`, or start the next statement on its own line.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning Jet.SemicolonAfterArm: Tests/UI/semicolon_after_arm.stderr.

  4 |     if ready -> print("ready"); print("done")
    |                               ^
 Why: A one-line arm holds one statement, so the code after this `;` could belong to the arm or run after it, and Jet will not guess which.
 Fix: Brace the arm to run both under it, as in `-> { a(); b() }`, or start the next statement on its own line.
